name: Bala Kanda
subtitle: The Beginning
description: The birth of Rama, his early adventures, training under Sage Vishwamitra, and the breaking of Shiva's bow at Mithila to win Sita's hand.

name: Ayodhya Kanda
subtitle: The Exile
description: A prince renounces his throne the night before his coronation for his father's honour, and departs for 14 years of forest exile.

name: Aranya Kanda
subtitle: The Forest
description: Thirteen years in Dandaka, the encounters with sages and demons, the golden deer Maricha, and the abduction of Sita by Ravana.

name: Kishkindha Kanda
subtitle: The Alliance
description: Rama meets Hanuman, befriends the exiled monkey king Sugriva, slays Vali, and the vast Vanara army is raised to search for Sita.

name: Sundara Kanda
subtitle: The Beautiful
description: Hanuman's heroic leap across the ocean, finding Sita in the Ashoka grove, the burning of Lanka, and delivering Sita's chudamani to Rama.

name: Yuddha Kanda
subtitle: The War
description: The building of Rama Setu, the epic war in Lanka, the fall of Kumbhakarna, Indrajit, and Ravana, Sita's trial by fire, and the victorious return to Ayodhya.

name: Uttara Kanda
subtitle: The Legacy
description: The righteous reign of Rama (Ramrajya), the origins of Ravana, the birth of Lava and Kusha, the singing of the Ramayana, and Rama's final ascent.
